## 📝 Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this PR introduces, fixes, or refactors, and the reasoning behind it.

## 🔗 Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number) or Relates to #(issue number)

## 🧪 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement (`perf:`)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update (`docs:`)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring (`refactor:`)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (`test:`)
- [ ] 🔧 CI/CD or tooling (`ci:` / `chore:`)

## ✅ Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's [Design Principles and Code of Conduct](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have verified all tests pass locally: `cargo test --locked`.
- [ ] I have verified Clippy reports zero warnings: `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`.
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `cargo fmt --check`.
- [ ] All commit messages adhere to [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
- [ ] I have added automated tests for any new functionality or regression tests for bugs.
